topics.title: Primary reference directory
topics.summary: This directory identifies primary language, toolchain, and operating-system documentation. The numbered curriculum and compact examples are retained from the earlier Book IV supplied in this conversation. The expanded explanations, diagnostic scenarios, labs, and extended server are new instructional material for this revision. References distinguish platform contracts from design choices in the fictional HarborWorks examples. No timing or hardware values are presented as universal constants.
